assembly_order: Print the bearing, motor-corner, shaft-access and axial-height coupons; select offsets before printing the drive.
Heat-set all inserts. Slide the output bearing onto the journal sleeve from its open upper end; its lower inner-race shoulder is integral.
Slide the sleeve/bearing over the front of the motor and park it 18 mm below its final position. Do not pass it over the rear connector.
Fasten the circular-spline motor plate with four M4×12 cap screws from above. Hold each exposed rear-flange nut 5° from its corner diagonal before raising the sleeve.
Raise the sleeve to the motor plate and tighten its four M3×8 screws from below through the Ø5.8 counterbores.
Stack each roller pair with four middle shims and one end shim at each carrier plate, contacting only the bearing inner races.
Fit the roller axle cap, tighten the screws against the metal stacks, and check that all four rollers spin freely.
Place the drum roof-down. Install the flex and assembled carrier through its open bottom, then lower the motor assembly in.
Enter the bearing into the drum's ribbed seat; fit the rotating lower outer-race cap and tighten its eight screws from below.
With the hex key removed, jog the motor slowly until the V-notched ports and clamp socket line up. Disconnect motor power before inserting the key and tightening the clamp.
Attach the payload using the six M3 inserts on a 68 mm pitch circle. Hand-turn through a complete cycle and verify no binding before applying power.

checks.name: Prototype fit comparison
checks.measurement_basis: All Generated values are extracted from BRep sections, cylindrical faces or plane locations. Tooth counts count section root arcs. Harmonic module uses measured rigid tip diameter/flex count; planetary module uses measured tip-minus-root radius divided by 2.25. Helix angle uses root-arc phase change over a measured 0.1 mm axial increment. No parameter-only value enters the fit pass/fail gate.

checks.name: Operating mesh relative to printed prototype
checks.basis: Candidate and original STL sections use the same geometric surrogate. Absolute overlap is retained. The 0.10 mm² area and 0.05 mm depth margins cover section tessellation and rounded sketch dimensions. Areas normalize by tooth count × module², depths by module.
checks.limits: Regression check only: no material stiffness, tooth compliance, local contact force, loaded backlash or fatigue prediction. Planetary contact geometry allows hoop compression; it is not an inextensible ellipse or a measured deformation field.

checks.name: Full-revolution rotating-part clearance
checks.model: Radial/axial envelopes for independent relative rotations; local planet spin about its axle; flex material phases in the wave-fixed carrier frame. Rigid co-motion and axisymmetric bearing spin use the solid-pair check.
